name: ICS Calendar
summary: Fetch upcoming events from a published ICS calendar feed

tools.name: ics_calendar_fetch
tools.description: Fetch upcoming events from a published ICS calendar feed.

days.description: Number of days ahead to fetch (default 7)

env_var.description: Environment variable name holding the ICS URL (e.g. CALENDAR_TRIPIT_ICS_URL)

label.description: Display name for this calendar in output (e.g. 'Nicole', 'TripIt', 'Family')
